checkpoint_precision: publisher BF16 checkpoint; automatic BF16 KV cache; no quantization
generation_choice_basis: Publisher sampling defaults; one fixed seed, medium thinking and 4096 total output tokens fixed before Qwen benchmark outputs; no search or test-driven changes.
prompt_policy: Exact released RL build_prompt with full native input allowlist and source flags; one Qwen chat user message, complete original sequence/context, no annotation or teacher fields, no extra retrieval or options.
metric_policy: Unmodified author SFT-aligned continuation GO extractor; ontology is_a/part_of closure including roots and unknown-ID self terms; uniform weight per propagated term; arithmetic mean of per-protein P/R/F1 across all planned cases. Author resolve_gold_terms_from_row unions curated leaf/ancestor fields AND go_pred_leaf while go_pred is supplied as context. Native reference and input are dependent: the metric can reward recovery/copying of supplied predictions and does not isolate novel function inference. Preserve that augmented target as primary; curated-only reference union is a separate fixed diagnostic, also with predictor overlap and unknown historical independence. Never select the more favorable metric or remove native context.
paper_comparison: Same exact released ID6989/OOD7883 species split and source RL text prompt/native set-F1 adaptation; different frozen zero-shot Qwen3.8-27B, chat template and4096-token generation, no author training/checkpoint replication. Author resolve_gold_terms_from_row unions curated leaf/ancestor fields AND go_pred_leaf while go_pred is supplied as context. Native reference and input are dependent: the metric can reward recovery/copying of supplied predictions and does not isolate novel function inference. Preserve that augmented target as primary; curated-only reference union is a separate fixed diagnostic, also with predictor overlap and unknown historical independence. Never select the more favorable metric or remove native context.
pretraining_contamination: Unknown; local inference and shuffled choices cannot establish contamination-free performance.
source_contract_disagreements: Published paper describes protein ESM3/projector-conditioned SFT and RL; released train_protein_grpo.py instead loads standalone AutoModelForCausalLM and full text sequence/context without an ESM3 encoder.

Released SFT evaluator chooses hf_reasoning loader; these CSVs lack explicit user/system columns, so that path uses generic default instructions and omits metadata. This prospective baseline follows the separate released RL prompt, not that SFT path.

Paper describes PPI and includes a name-header example; released RL eval explicitly disables PPI, and optional singular protein_name is absent. Plural protein_names is scorer-only and never substituted.
Released RL evaluator default512newtokens/T0.7 differs from fixed4096-token Qwen recipe. No outcome-guided change, no checkpoint selection or training is performed.

Original RL tokenizer decodes continuation with skip_special_tokens=True; Qwen3.8 API exposes generated reasoning/final channels. Only generated channels are reconstructed for native extraction, with no prompt context; tokenizer-level byte identity is not claimed.

Source prompt is preserved verbatim inside a single user message, using pinned Qwen3.8 chat template rather than author's raw tokenizer call. Complete sequences retained, no native SFT2000-residue truncation.

prospective_interpretation.actually_supplied: Complete sequence, organism, full native InterPro and GO-GPT predicted context, exact released RL prompt/summary-tag instruction. No names, curated GO, teacher trace, expression, structures or PPI.
prospective_interpretation.reference_answer_source: Primary native union of curated GO plus predictor go_pred_leaf, dependent on supplied go_pred context; curated-only diagnostic has predictor overlap too, with historical independence unverified. Both references scorer-only.
prospective_interpretation.good_score_establishes: Agreement with the frozen augmented target, potentially by recovering/copying supplied predictor GO terms; not isolated novel function inference. Curated-only diagnostic separately measures recorded annotation recovery with declared input overlap.
prospective_interpretation.bad_score_establishes: Limited recovery under the chosen full-sequence/context interface; does not isolate reasoning, rule out unannotated functions, or dismiss learned specialist representations.
prospective_interpretation.explanation_correctness: Unassessed independently. Correct GO predictions do not validate rationales; missing support does not automatically mean false.

seed_predictor_overlap.interpretation: Offline input/reference dependence audit using exactly GO IDs already supplied in go_pred. This is not a Qwen inference result or context ablation. Native target augmentation can reward recovery/copying of supplied predictions; curated annotations also overlap input predictions, whose historical training/data independence is unknown.

incomplete_output_policy: Wait for every source shard terminal; lock all outputs/missing slots before labels; preserve every planned failure as empty GO set. Score native augmented-reference mean GO-F1 once per complete ID/OOD union, curated-only diagnostic separately. Nonzero source generation remains nonzero aggregate status. No retries/resampling or score selection.
